games.name: HOURS
games.desc:
Seize control of time itself to break through waves of foes in this singleplayer hack and slash with roguelite elements.

Features:
- 15 different characters called "Hosts" to play as, such as the Invader, the Witness and the Vestige.
- Mix and match them with 32 unique time powers called "Tempo". Stop time, go through time loops or predict the future. Time itself is yours to command.
- A variety of upgrades with powerful effects unique to each Host that promote various playstyles.
- Fight more than 30 challenging enemies and bosses that will test your skill to the max.
- All returns to nothing when you die. Your actions may be meaningless, but will you push forward and reach the end in spite of that?
- Face off against the most advanced AI on Roblox in endless mode.

Like this game? Share it, tell your friends, spread the word! Or buy Hands of Time, the game's premium gamepass!

games.name: Bloxrooms [Beta]
games.desc:
Endless rooms. Familiar places. Nothing is quite right.

Bloxrooms takes the games you think you remember and twists them into something that was never supposed to exist. Explore endless levels, uncover strange artifacts, and survive entities that don't follow the rules you thought you knew. The deeper you go, the more reality starts to fall apart. Every room feels familiar—but never exactly how you remember it.

🗺️ Explore Misremembered Levels
Discover corrupted areas inspired by games that feel strangely familiar.

👁️ Survive the Unknown
Watch for entities, study their behavior, and know when to run—or hide.

💎 Scavenge for Artifacts
Search each level for valuable artifacts and bring them back for cash.

🛠️ Upgrade Your Gear
Use your earnings to improve your equipment and push deeper into the rooms.

games.name: [💥🔺 UPD 1.7] untitled robot boxing
games.desc:
- THIS GAME IS GETTING REWORKED! THANK YOU FOR PLAYING THE ALPHA! -

make robots fight viciously with dynamic controls, and clanking noises.

Untitled Robot Boxing is a game heavily inspired by Real Steel. It is a 1v1 fighting game where you're put in 5 rounds that last 2 minutes. Your objective is to win by knocking out the enemy, winning by decision, or tearing their parts off!

• You earn Currency which you can use to spin for more robots 💵
• Perform a wide range of combos with the game's dynamic controls! 🕹
• Fight your way to the top! Can you make it to the top 10? 🏆

====
CONTROLS

I/J - LIGHT
K/L - HEAVY

D + I/J/K/L - FORWARD VARIANT ATTACK
S + I/J/K/L - DOWNWARD VARIANT ATTACK

F - HIGH BLOCK
V - LOW BLOCK

SPACE + WASD - DASH
SHIFT + WASD  - WEAVE

P - TECH MOVE/SPECIAL MOVE
====

• Game made as a solo dev. Thanks for playin'! Bugs or suggestions? Visit our social links!

games.name: Flood Escape: Classic
games.desc:
Locked in a flooding facility, you and your team must work together to push buttons, find the way out, crack the code and escape before the flood takes you!

Flood Escape Classic started development in September 2011, and is what kickstarted the Flood Escape series.

FEC persisted through many of Roblox's fundamental changes; Mobile Support, Dynamic Lighting, Filtering Enabled and many more.

While the game doesn't get updated often now due to focus on FE2, FEC's continued community and player count shows that the game continues to offer a solid experience for obby enthusiasts.
